scope: Claire and Marc Bourgie Pavilion at 1339 Sherbrooke Street West. The standing exterior includes 1894 church body and attached five-gallery building.

originalReview.notes: The verified original records the rounded Romanesque portals, rough pale-gray stone with warm surrounds, large fan-like semicircular window and tiers of arcade openings. From Sherbrooke the tall square bell tower is on the left, the smaller pyramidal slate roof on the right. The same native polygon encloses the rear marble-clad contemporary gallery described by its architects.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla images were screened first. Its exact Hornstein original refers to the 1912 pavilion, and the Inuit gallery photo shows interior exhibits. The Bourgie local rendition did not match the photographer’s original file. No museum or architects’ images were imported as appearance sources.
